sn46.19:1.1: Sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ariyā niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāya || katame satta || || Satisambojjhaṅgo || la-pe || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo || || Ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ariyā niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāyāti || ||
